{{Top|leg}}
The '''HNE Headquarters''' was a building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that housed the [[HoloNet News and Entertainment]].<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

==History==
During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], it was one of the targets of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. The building was successfully defended by [[Omega Squad]], [[Yayax Squad]] and [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Aven (clone trooper)|Aven]].<ref name="O66" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'' {{1st}}
